newsitem.title: UK: LME copper ticks higher in late trading.
newsitem.headline: LME copper ticks higher in late trading.

text.p: LME copper looked at the upside in late inter-office trading on Monday evening but failed to match the day's highs.
At 1800 GMT, three month copper was indicated at $2,326/30 per tonne, up from an afternoon kerb close of $2,319.
During the day it hit a peak of $2,340, a resistance level.

One trader said the market may be anticipating another moderate rise in LME stocks on Tuesday in contrast to several big deliveries last week which added a total of 42,025 tonnes to stocks. Inventories only rose 3,250 tonnes on Monday.
Prices were likely to gain in the short-term towards $2,350 and $2,365, the top of a gap, as technical tightness continues until the end of the week, analysts said.
The cash/threes backwardation remained strong at $142/$150, slightly wider than on Friday, due to borrowing of August/threes earlier in the day.
